name: Truck Crossing
spec: yellow diamond with a black truck symbol
meaning: Trucks may be entering or crossing ahead.

snippets.back: The front No-Zone is about cutting in too soon after passing, while the turning No-Zone is about never passing on the right of a truck signaling a right turn.
A truck signaling a right turn may swing wide to the left first, so stop behind the white stop line or it may not be able to turn without hitting you.
Green national truck signs mark routes and ramps where trucks are allowed, while red ones mark where trucks are prohibited or where designated routes end.
